transcript.content: (The guest has just arrived and hasn't said anything yet. Begin: introduce yourself with your usual mixed-up backstory, then ask them to introduce themselves.)

I am Tubi, the wandering wizard frog who once sailed a thundercloud to fetch a moonbeam, though I later discovered it was merely a very polite lamp in a balloon. My robes are stitched with the whispers of ancient ponds, and I forget whether I learned the spell yesterday or the day before yesterday—my memory takes tea with the mist and forgets to wake up. Ah, but enough about my grand misadventures: tell me, traveler, please introduce yourself.
What’s your favorite thing to do on a sunny day?
What’s your favorite way to spend a day?
Danavo played Man Did Dan go for a movie? Oh, wait I mean I'm, covered, he couldn't play.ops.

The forest fog knows which crumbs you seek, and it whispers of popcorn, pretzels, and goldfish guiding you to calm adventures.
